introduction.p1: This app is an 'Integrative Medicine Guide' that combines Eastern medicine (Kampo) and Western medicine knowledge. Using AI, it provides comprehensive information about Kampo formulas, Western herbs, and supplements from both medical perspectives.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content:
This Privacy Policy explains how Self-Care Guide for Wellness ("the App") handles information about its users. The App requires no account and never asks for your name or email address.

**1. Where your searches are sent**
When you search, your search terms and display language are sent through the App's server (provided by Vercel Inc.) to the Gemini API, a generative AI service provided by Google LLC, which uses them to generate the answer. The App's server does not store your search terms or write them to its logs.
Google handles the content it receives under the Google Privacy Policy and the Gemini API Terms of Service. Google may use submitted content to improve its services, so please do not enter information that could identify you, such as your name, contact details, or patient ID numbers.

**2. Information stored on your device**
Your recent searches (search terms and their results, up to 20), display language, and font size are stored only in your browser (localStorage) and are never sent to the App's server.
You can delete your search history with "Clear history" on the search screen, and the other settings by clearing this site's data in your browser. Please keep this in mind on shared devices.

**3. Use of IP addresses**
To prevent excessive requests in a short time (rate limiting), your IP address is converted into a form that cannot be reversed (hashed) and kept only temporarily, for a few minutes. The App may use a database service from Upstash, Inc. for this. Your IP address itself is never stored.

**4. Access logs**
Vercel Inc., which hosts the App, may record access logs such as IP addresses and access times to operate and secure the service.

**5. Cookies, analytics, and advertising**
The App does not use cookies, analytics tools, or advertising.

**6. Changes to this policy**
This policy may be updated as needed. Significant changes will be announced on this page.

**7. Contact**
For questions about this policy, please open an issue in the App's GitHub repository.

Effective date: November 23, 2026

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.content:
These Terms of Service ("the Terms") set out the conditions for using Self-Care Guide for Wellness ("the App"). By using the App, you agree to the Terms.

**1. The service**
The App is a free information service that uses generative AI (Google Gemini) to provide general information about Kampo formulas, Western herbs, and supplements. The content shown is generated automatically by AI and has not been individually reviewed by the operator.

**2. Not medical care**
The App is not a substitute for diagnosis, treatment, or advice from a doctor or other healthcare professional. Do not use it to diagnose or treat any condition, or to decide whether to start, change, or stop any medication.
If you have symptoms, take any medication, have a medical condition, or are pregnant or breastfeeding, always consult a doctor or pharmacist before use. In an emergency, do not use the App — call your local emergency number (119 in Japan) immediately.

**3. Your responsibility**
You use the information obtained from the App at your own judgment and responsibility.

**4. Prohibited conduct**
You must not:
• Violate any law or public order and morals
• Place an excessive load on the App's servers or network, including sending large numbers of automated requests
• Gain or attempt to gain unauthorized access
• Interfere with the operation of the App
• Present content generated by the App to others as if it were medical advice
• Engage in any other conduct the operator deems inappropriate

**5. Disclaimer of warranties and liability**
The operator makes no warranty as to the accuracy, completeness, timeliness, or usefulness of the information provided by the App.
Except in cases of the operator's intent or gross negligence, the operator is not liable for any damage arising from the use of, or inability to use, the App. This does not apply where the operator is liable under the Consumer Contract Act of Japan or other applicable laws.

**6. Changes to or suspension of the service**
The operator may change the App or suspend it temporarily or permanently without prior notice.

**7. Changes to the Terms**
The operator may change the Terms as needed. The revised Terms take effect when posted on this page.

**8. Governing law and jurisdiction**
The Terms are governed by the laws of Japan. Any dispute concerning the App shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction, in the first instance, of the court having jurisdiction over the operator's location.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.content:
The information provided by the App is for educational and general informational purposes only. It is not a substitute for diagnosis, treatment, or professional medical advice from a doctor.

**About AI-generated content**
Search results are created automatically by generative AI (Google Gemini). They may contain errors, outdated information, or omissions, and the same search can return different content. Before making any important decision, always check with a doctor, pharmacist, or other professional, or with official sources.

**Using Kampo formulas, herbs, and supplements**
Kampo formulas are medicines. Herbs and supplements can also cause harm depending on drug interactions and individual constitution. If you take any medication, are pregnant or breastfeeding, have a medical condition, or are considering use for a child or older adult, always consult a doctor or pharmacist first. If you notice anything unusual, stop using the product and see a doctor.

**In an emergency**
If symptoms are severe, sudden, or getting worse, do not use the App — see a doctor or call your local emergency number (119 in Japan) immediately.
